# netskopebwan_gateway_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskopebwan_gateway_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
  type = "hub"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Must be one of: `hub`, `spoke`.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `gateways` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways))
